notes.title: UPDATE 1.23 - Small Tweaks Per User Feedback & Possible Complete Overhaul Coming
notes.content:
Hello, this update is the first for Laser Ball in a long time and is here now per the suggestions and feedback of Steam user Mihailovich on the feedback forums recently.

In this update, I've decreased the size of the deposit bin hit box so that it hopefully no longer feels as if you can "throw" a ball into the bin from very far away.  For any players who've played this game in the past, you may now just need to be sure you move your character a little closer to the deposit bin before being able to drop the ball in.

I've also changed the deposit area so that when you are needing to shoot the ball, it shows the color of your "target ball" here as well as the border of the screen as seen here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32345131/252892ddd832278baea963b19bf1f1ed1441b87d.jpg[/img]

When you've already shot and neutralized the target ball and picked it up, the bottom deposit ball area now simply tells you to "deposit the ball here" with an arrow as seen here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32345131/6ad0d5a5bb5de5d296c8e3842ea7f4035f076a84.jpg[/img]



I MAY DO A COMPLETE OVERHAUL OF THIS GAME FROM SCRATCH IN THE COMING MONTHS:

When I made these changes to the code today, I couldn't help but notice how much my coding skills have developed since I developed this game way back in early 2018.

This game launched in March of 2018, so I have decided that I might just work on a complete overhaul of this game in time for a "5 Year Anniversary" of my original Laser Ball launch.  

If I do an overhaul of this game, I believe it would be a much improved version of what I did nearly five years ago now.  Laser Ball was only my 2nd Steam game release, and now I have 10 Steam games under my belt.  I've learned a lot since I coded this game and would love to see how much I could improve this game with a complete rebuild.

If I do overhaul this game, I want to promise two things:

1) This current version of Laser Ball would always be available to play by simply putting in an access code into the BETA properties that I would make available with an overhaul launch.  This way anyone could easily go back and play this 'old school' version should they desire at any time and/or anyone could easily switch between versions at any point just to see the difference.

2) The new overhaul updated version would replace this current version and the price would NOT change.  All current owners of this game would get the new updated and overhauled version completely free, and it would be the default version going forward.  This rebuild would just be for 'fun' and to see how much better I can make this game with my current game development skills and because I do care about the quality of the products I sell here on Steam.


..Again, I want to thank the Steam user Mihailovich for his feedback and suggestions that helped make this update a reality.

Feel free to post any feedback, suggestions, or ideas below about this update or my ideas of overhauling Laser Ball in the near future!


Sincerely, 

ZaxtorGameS  ..  ..  (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.22 - Generator Repairs Now Reward You Points + Ball/Player Fixes
notes.content:
In this update:

- The Electro-Blob will now spawn in the top middle of the screen at a random position if you are playing the Electro Blob mode when you deposit the multi-colored ball after NOT neutralizing it with the laser gun (due to it becoming neutral in color because the timer ran out).  ..So no longer can you just wait until the timer runs out to deposit the multicolored ball without spawning the Electro-Blob if you choose this mode of the game.

---------------------

- I've fixed the way the charged balls behave when they touch you.  Before they would move to the players position unintentionally and this would sometimes be the cause of the balls getting caught on the borders or even in the player safe zone.  The balls will now no longer move to the players position when they shock and kill the player.  They should now keep their coordinates and sometimes reflect off the player as intended.

---------------------

- Repairing the generator now rewards the player with a small amount of points.

The points are consistent regardless of the level you are on.
  
You will score 500 points if you repair the generator from a broken state (0% to 49%) and don't have to move away during the repair progress until the repairs are completed to start the generator.

You will score 35 points if you repair the generator when it's already running and start the repairs anywhere from 50% to 85%.  Again, you'll need to get the generator to 100% repaired without moving away to get the 35 points.

If you start repairs at a generator repair level at 86% or higher, you'll score no points.      

---------------------

- Added a message in the tutorial to show the player the generator and that it needs to be repaired and kept repaired.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.21 - ElectroBlob gets even deadlier! Plus Numerous Fixes!
notes.content:
In this patch, I've made the Electro-Blob even more challenging to face as he now shoots as you as before in update 1.20, but now he will continue bouncing around the screen for several seconds at the same velocity!  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32345131/27945362a699b699f8c738da563e40a040221b5c.png[/img]

I've also added new sounds as well as adjusted all of the game sounds to give it all a good balance.

Multiple things to note with this update:

1)  To get the 1,000 points for dodging the Electro Blob's charge attack, you need to be out of the safe zone on the left side of the screen when the Electro-Blob turns back to his normal white color and you need to have been out of the safe zone for more than half of his charge attack time.

2) You can now repair the generator at any time it has regressed, not only when it is in need of repair with more than 50% damage done.

3) Be careful with the laser gun as if you shoot your generator, it will be instantly destroyed and at zero repair status!

4) The acid that fills your safety zone will now be drained if the Electro-Blob touches a ball you've neutralized and turns it back to its original charged color.  This change was made to allow you to control the gun from the safe zone in this scenario.

Also, while the balls may occasionally get stuck bouncing on the border of the room, this should be very rare now.  I am continuing to adjust and tweak recent code changes to fix this problem until hopefully it never happens at all.  

Note that if a ball does ever somehow leave the screen due to an add bounce or situation where you die while carrying it, it will be immediately placed back into the middle of the room.

I have added a grey cable that runs across the top of the room floor from the generator to the control panel to help visually show how they are connected.


That's about it.  There's a lot of little changes I made in this update, but I think I've covered most of them here.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.10 - Global Steam High Scores Available In Game Plus HUGE SCORING CHANGES!
notes.content:
Okay everyone..  Laser Ball launched just under a year ago today on Steam and with this one year anniversary, I felt a couple of changes were really needed in this game.  The first was adding global high scores directly to the game for easy access to see where you rank and the second was an over-hauled scoring system to better reward players for choosing to take on the Electro-Blob but not penalizing players for choosing to play without it in their games.  

---------- New Global High Scores Added: ----------

No more needing to go to the Steam leaderboards here on the Steam page for Laser Ball just to see where your score ranks!

All the high scores are available right from the welcome screen in Laser Ball anytime you play!  WooHoo!


---------- New More Fair and Balanced Scoring System ----------

Also a big change in this update is more points for facing the Electro-Blob and more specifically.. you'll now be rewarded points for depositing balls when the Electro-Blob is zapping around the game room.

**************
IMPORTANT NOTE:  WITH THIS UPDATE AND ADDITION OF BONUS ELECTRO-BLOB DEPOSIT BONUS POINTS, THE 30% PENALTY FOR ELECTING TO NOT PLAY AGAINST THE ELECTRO-BLOB HAS BEEN REMOVED.  ALL SCORING IS THE SAME FOR EVERY EVENT WHETHER OR NOT YOU CHOOSE TO PLAY AGAINST THE ELECTRO BLOB.  THE DIFFERENCE NOW IS YOU'LL GET THE ELECTRO_BLOB BONUS POINTS EXPLAINED BELOW IF YOU FACE THE ELECTRO-BLOB.
***************

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32345131/e562e93dd4fb8396b0f863cbd95da79d02db7dbf.png[/img]


Here's how the new Electro-Blob scoring works:

- You MUST have the Electro-Blob on the screen when you deposit a ball to score these bonus points.  If you haven't yet shot the multi-colored ball that spawns the Electro-Blob when you deposit a ball, you'll get no extra points.

- The more balls you deposit on any level while the Electro-Blob exists, the more "Electro-Blob Deposit Points" you'll be rewarded.  This helps balance the game and levels giving you more points the earlier in a level that the multi-colored border comes up and the creates the need to spawn this unpredictable enemy.

The scoring works as follows:

The level you are currently on is multiplied by:
The number of balls you've deposited on any given level while the Electro-Blob exists Multiplied by (a random score between 25 to 40)

So let's give you a few example scores:

On Level 2 facing the Electro-Blob, the multi-colored ball is the 3rd ball requested by the border of the game.  Balls 1 and 2 that you deposit give you no additional points because the Electro-Blob hadn't yet spawned.
Now you deposit the mutli-colored ball you've neutralized white with the laser gun and the Electro-Blob is in play.  You'll score [2] for being on level 2 MULTIPLIED BY [a random number between 25 and 40] meaning you'll score somewhere between 50 and 80 extra points for this deposited ball.

The very next ball you shoot is the purple ball as requested by the border color.  You neutralize it with the laser gun and collect it escaping the fast moving Electro-Blob by a narrow margin!  Whew!  Because this is the 2nd ball you deposited on level 2 while the Electro-Blob has existed, you'll score [2] for level 2 MULTIPLIED BY [2 for 2nd ball deposited this level] times 25 to 40 points.  So this deposited ball will reward you with somewhere between 100 to 160 extra points

Now let's move to level 12.  You have advanced to level 12 and the very first ball you had to neutralize was the multi-colored ball on this level which spawned the Electro-Blob.  Because you've had to neutralize every ball and deposit every ball on this level while the Electro-Blob has been bouncing around the screen, you'll score a LOT more bonus points for succeeding this level.  Let's imagine this is the 8th ball on this level you've just deposited, so this bonus just for this ball will be [12] (for being on level 12) MULTIPLIED BY [8] (8th ball deposited this level) times the 25 to 40 point random score.  This means this deposited ball will score you somewhere between 2,400 and 3,840 points!  And if you deposit that last 9th ball to clear out level 12, you'll get another 2,700 to 4,320 bonus points!   

This could really add up fast as you advance through the levels especially if you have a lot of levels where the multicolored ball is an early target and you end up facing the Electro-Blob much of your levels.

To help you see the difference, let's show you the 
TOTAL POSSIBLE ELECTRO-BLOB DEPOSIT POINTS AT LEVEL 10 when the Electro Blob is released early because the multicolored ball is chose by the border first VERSUS when the Electro-Blob comes into play late because the multicolored ball is selected by the border last:

:: LEVEL 10 ::
Electro Blob is only in play 1 ball as border chooses multicolor ball last:

1st Deposited Ball:  Maximum Bonus: 0 - (Electro-Blob isn't in play)
2nd Deposited Ball:  Maximum Bonus: 0 - (Electro-Blob isn't in play)
3rd Deposited Ball:  Maximum Bonus: 0 - (Electro-Blob isn't in play)
4th Deposited Ball:  Maximum Bonus: 0 - (Electro-Blob isn't in play)
5th Deposited Ball:  Maximum Bonus: 0 - (Electro-Blob isn't in play)
6th Deposited Ball:  Maximum Bonus: 0 - (Electro-Blob isn't in play)
7th Deposited Ball:  Maximum Bonus: 0 - (Electro-Blob isn't in play)
8th Deposited Ball:  Maximum Bonus: 0 - (Electro-Blob isn't in play)
9th Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  250  ::  Maximum Bonus: 400
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TOTAL on level 10 (If multicolored ball is last):  Min: 250 :: Max: 400

* VERSUS *

:: LEVEL: 10  ::  
Electro Blob in play all 9 Balls (Border chooses multicolor ball first):

1st Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  250  ::  Maximum Bonus: 400
2nd Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  500  ::  Maximum Bonus: 800
3rd Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  750  ::  Maximum Bonus: 1,200
4th Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  1,000  ::  Maximum Bonus: 1,600
5th Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  1,250  ::  Maximum Bonus: 2,000
6th Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  1,500  ::  Maximum Bonus: 2,400
7th Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  1,750  ::  Maximum Bonus: 2,800
8th Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  2,000  ::  Maximum Bonus: 3,200
9th Deposited Ball:  Minimum Bonus:  2,250  ::  Maximum Bonus: 3,600
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TOTAL on level 10 (If multicolored ball is first):  Min: 11,250 :: Max: 18,000

* As you can see from the two outcomes above, the longer the Electro-Blob is in play on any given level, the higher your total bonus will be.  This should help reward players who not only choose to face the Electro-Blob, but who actually do well while it is in play 

Please keep in mind that choosing the "Level 10 Quick Start" option while facing the Electro-Blob will NOT give you any of the extra points you might score if you actually play the first ten levels and face the Electro-Blob (because you aren't actually facing the Electro-Blob the first ten levels by skipping those levels with the Quick Start option)


I hope you enjoy the changes made to Laser Ball in this update!  Feel free and let me know with a thumbs up or even better with a comment below!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.08 - Minor Change in Ball Code for Better, More Predictable Bounce Angles
notes.content:
This update is nothing new for the player except a complete overhaul in the way the balls bounce against the outside walls to provide for more efficient and more realistic bounce angles.

It's funny how this stuff works..  I fought for hours on getting the bounce angles correct around the launch of Laser Ball last spring, almost a year ago now and never was completely happy.  When I started work on a new game I call PrisonBall which is a game I expect to launch in the coming months, the ball bouncing code just kinda game to me without much effort or thought and using that same, much simpler code in Laser Ball for this update seems to provide better results here as well.

Anyhow, that is all for this update and I hope you have or are enjoying this retro game inspired by an old type in game I loved on my Commodore 64 back in the 80s today!  ..I wouldn't have remade it today if I didn't firmly believe it was worth a newer fancier version for our computers today!  =)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.07 - Quick Start Changed From Level 5 .. To Level 10!
notes.content:
Previously, the Quick Start Option was a way to start your games at level 5 with 6 lives and 25,000 points and was unlocked once you achieved level 5 with at least 6 lives and 25,000 points one time on your account.

The Quick Start has been changed in this update 1.07 to an option to start at level 10 with 8 lives and 100,000 points.  

The old quick start has been removed and changed now, so you'll need to achieve level 10 with at least 8 lives and 100,000 points to unlock the Quick Start option.  .It won't be real easy to unlock this as you'll to make it to level 10 without losing a single life and you'll need to either score a lot of accuracy bonuses if you choose to play without the Electro-Blob in play or still do well even against the Electro-Blob!  ..It IS very possible to unlock this new Quick Start however, it just won't be as easy as it was to unlock the previous level 5 Quick Start option.

If you had previously unlocked the level 5 Quick Start, it will not help you with this new Quick Start in this update.  Every player will need to unlock this new Quick Start to be able to use it starting with this update.

This was the only change made for update 1.07 but I feel will help experienced players get to the faster and more challenging levels quicker while giving new players a little tougher challenge to unlock this new Quick Start option.

Good luck and have fun!  =)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.06 - Critical Game Sabotaging Bug Fix + More!
notes.content:
I would like to give a HUGE shout out to Steam user Kinzoku for posting a critical bug that would cause you to sometimes no longer be able to finish a game.  Kinzoku posted this screenshot in the bug reports forum thread that showed how in one game where a ton of points were scored, the border color suddenly demanded a color that didn't have a matching ball to shoot!
https://puu.sh/BnhKW/4489eb2215.png

I believe I've tracked this bug down, and as usual, it was a super simple mistake made when I was coding my game where I put a 1 instead of the letter l in a variable name.  Ugh, silly me!

*-* Update 1.06 also includes all new more efficient ball bouncing code to handle the way the balls bounce against the walls.  It was only 13 lines of code removed, but when you realize that your computer reads those lines of code 60 times a second as the game runs at 60 fps and it read those extra lines for all nine balls (if nine balls were bouncing around).. that means this code clean up saved the game needing to read and process 7,020 lines of code every second!  (13 lines of code TIMES 9 potential balls TIMES 60 times a second = 7,020)

*-* The update also adds a new line of my voice directing players who start the tutorial on how to use the control panel to use the laser gun to shoot the ball that matches the border color.  In watching a recent video of the game played, it was obvious that my tutorial with just text telling the player what to do (and arrows) wasn't quite enough as the video showed the player extremely confused on what to do, even using the tutorial.  Hopefully this added voice instruction will help new players understand the basic objective of this game!

*-* One additional voice was added to the game, and that is my sons voice recording which has been added to help warn you when you are standing in harms way of acid filling up in the safe zone.  If lives can be saved from being eaten by acid with this new voice recording being added, then it was worth this extra effort!  ;-)

Please let me know if this update creates any problems or things you don't like, or if any bugs are found while playing!

I hope you enjoy!  =)   Thanks again to Kinzoku!  This bug report was MUCH appreciated and help makes this game a better experience for all players!  <3

notes.title: UPDATE 1.05 - Improved Ball / Border Bounces AND Ball Tearing Issues Resolved!
notes.content:
In this update which comes right at the same time as the previously announced price increase to Laser Ball, I've fixed a couple of issues that had my head spinning when I noticed them.  Neither issue happened much, at least on my computers, but I seemed to notice it more when I watched other people play my game...


BALLS MOMENTARILY SLIDING ALONG BORDERS RESOLVED:
________________________________________________________

The balls have now been completely re-coded to make sure that the issues that sometimes occurred where a ball would slide along the edge of the border has been fixed.  


SPRITE TEARING HAS BEEN FIXED:
_______________________________

Also previously, at higher levels and faster ball speeds, you'd sometimes notice sprite tears as you moved across the screen, and it seemed to happen more often as you carried a ball.  That issue has been completely fixed now.


DOUBLE BONUS POINTS FOR COMPLETING A LEVEL EARLY:
_______________________________________________________

If you deposit all nine balls to the deposit basket and have time remaining, you'll now score double the bonus points seen previously.  This has been changed to make it more balanced versus the accuracy points scored for not missing a laser shot.  Keep in mind that you must deposit all nine balls before the balls turn safe automatically and the timer starts to score this time bonus.


I think that is it for this update!  Please let me know if you experience any new oddities while playing this game, and my BUGS forum thread is the best place to give me that feedback!

Thanks for reading (and playing)!!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.04 - Laser Gun "Auto Aim" has been removed, pixel perfect shots now
notes.content:
Early in development of Laser Ball, way before I had the idea to add such thing as an "accuracy bonus", I added a laser shot "auto-aim" in the same manner I added auto aim to the smaller rocks in Rock N Roll to help you land shots easier.

But when my 12 year old son was playing my game recently, he noticed an issue of balls he didn't want to hit getting hit as well as his target ball because of the auto aim I had added.  This, as you know causes your accuracy bonus to fail at the end of each level, even if you miss a single shot or miss a single shot.  

The problem happened specifically when two balls were really close together and you were trying to be really precise and perfect with your shots to hit the correct ball and not waiting until the balls might separate more.

To fix this, the balls hit box and the laser collision are now PIXEL PERFECT.  No more auto aim or added pixels to make landing shots easier.  This change will likely take some getting used to if you have spent much time playing Laser Ball.

I believe the game IS better without any auto-aim assistance as it will prevent you from hitting unintended balls and only hit balls actually touched precisely with your laser shots.  When the accuracy bonus in this game rewards you for not missing a single shot, pixel perfect shots are pretty much required.

That's the only change made in version 1.04 but it is a pretty significant one and might take some players a little getting used to.  Please let me know in the comments below what you think.

ALSO PLEASE REMEMBER THAT LASER BALL WILL BE INCREASING IN PRICE FROM 99 CENTS to $2.99 USD THIS FRIDAY MAY 11th.. As it was advised last week.  This price increase is expected to be approved with a targeted date of approval on Friday, May 11 and will be submitted to Steam late in the day on Thursday, May 10th.  Depending on how long it takes for Steam to approve the price increase, it could be effective as early as late Thursday, May 10 or as late as Monday, May 14.

Thanks for reading and have a good rest of your week!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.03 - More Balancing Tweaks.. Playing Against the Electro-Blob Now Spawns More Bonus Stars
notes.content:
In this small update, I've made a small tweak to the ways balls bounce off of walls in hopes it it lower the amount they seem to "slide" against the outer walls.  My ball bounces have gotten much better than before in recent updates, and I think I'm finally close to getting them right where I want.

Also, to help better balance the game on your decision to play against the Electro-Blob or turn the Electro-Blob off, I added about a double chance of the bonus point star sparkles of light spawning should you take on the more difficult challenge.

So to understand the full difference in the modes I've made these lists...


TURNING OFF THE ELECTRO-BLOB AT THE MAIN SCREEN (Checked):

- You'll score 30% less points on all scoring events except for accuracy bonuses awarded a the end of each level
- You'll have a lower spawn rate on the collectible sparkle of lights (immediate bonus points)
- Your Timer will be normal based on your level and speed of the balls.

_______________________________________________________

PLAYING AGAINST THE ELECTRO-BLOB ON MAIN SCREEN (UnChecked):

- You'll score normal points of all scoring events (shooting the correct ball, depositing neutralized balls, collecting sparkles of light)
- You'll have a double spawn rate of collectible sparkles of light which could mean massive differences in score totals later in the game at high levels
- You'll get a minimum of 5 additional seconds on the timer to complete each level.  (It moves to 6 additional seconds at level 2, and 1 additional second for every two levels beyond level 2.. so 7 extra seconds at level 4, 8 extra seconds at level 6, etc)

I hope you all are enjoying Laser Ball!  If you are enjoying Laser Ball, please be sure to let all your friends on Steam know before May 11 so they can jump in and purchase the game before the scheduled price increase from 99 cents to $2.99 USD!

notes.title: ** NOTICE OF PRICE INCREASE TO $2.99 USD FRIDAY MAY 11, 2018 **

Hello everyone!

I am giving everyone a full weeks warning to make your purchase of Laser Ball at the early price tag of just 99 cents (USD)  before I plan on increasing the cost to $2.99 USD.

After putting more than triple the hours of work and extra content into Laser Ball that I never planned to this game before it launched, I strongly feel that Laser Ball has become a much better looking and more fun to play retro action game.  The new price also better matches other unique games such as Laser Ball with similar graphics and game styles.

Since the launch of Laser Ball, Laser Ball has had the graphics and look overhauled to a much cleaner and better overall appearance.  Laser Ball has had a whole new scoring system added to it to make advancing rewarding and interesting and this has taken a lot of time to both code and balance properly.  A new challenging and unpredictable enemy has also been added to the game with the addition of the Electro-Blob. - And Laser Ball has also had controller support and options for volume, quick-start, and the No Electro Ball mode added as well.

For anyone waiting on purchasing perhaps hoping to see Laser Ball on another website which offers bundle deals on indie games, please know that I have NO plans to ever offer my games on such websites again.  After doing such a deal with my first game Rock 'N Roll on IndieGala last summer, I quickly learned my lesson as it proved to be way more trouble in the end (and also cost more money) than it was worth in the end.  Any "bundle deals" with my games in the future will likely only be seen right here on Steam where I might offer bundle deals on my own games.  I have current plans of offering two new games currently in development and early in design stages before the end of 2018.  My new games planned are still very early in development but once I have three, four, or more games available here on Steam, you'll likely see the only "bundle offers" I ever plan on offering again on my games right here.

In the end, I very strongly believe that my games are well worth their price.  Laser Ball, like Rock 'N Roll is a game crafted with love, a strong passion to offer a fun-to-play game, and a high replay value.  My games will always be 100% self crafted from start to finish without using asset kits or stolen code or frameworks from some tutorial available online somewhere.  As an indie gamer and content creator who has evaluated over 500 Steam games myself on my YouTube channel in recent years, I am proud to say I'll never sell cheap asset flips or half completed games.  

This price increase is expected to be approved with a targeted date of approval on Friday, May 11 and will be submitted to Steam late in the day on Thursday, May 10th.  Depending on how long it takes for Steam to approve the price increase, it could be effective as early as late Thursday, May 10 or as late as Monday, May 14.

Thanks for reading this, be sure to pass the word to your friends before the price increases on May 11, and have a great weekend everyone!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.02 - A Little More Time Given If You Play Against the Electro-Blob and Slight Nerfs given to Electro-Blob speed increases
notes.content:
As I've stated before the release of version 1.0, this game would continue to get little patches as needed to adjust the balance of the game and any bugs that might come up.

With update 1.02 here, the only change is a little more time has been added if you choose to play against the Electro-Blob (You can turn the Electro-Blob off with a check mark option on the welcome screen)

The additional time given for accepting the Electro-Blob in your game is not much but I feel like it will help better balance the game.  The formula used is a base 5 seconds at level 1 plus an additional second added for every round level number you advance to.  So for example, at level 8 you'd get 5 additional seconds plus 4 seconds for the level 8 making a total of 9 additional seconds.  At level 10, you'd get the initial 5 seconds plus 5 more seconds for level 10 making a total of 10 additional seconds and so on.

This may be tweaked as needed.

The speed increases of the Electro-Blob as you advance in levels was also changed to a more gradual increase once you reach level 15.  Before this patch, the maximum speed of the Electro-Blob went up the same small amount every level, and with this patch, the maximum speed gradually declines after level 15.  Keep in mind that the Electro-Blob will still have a higher maximum speed every time you advance a level in your game, however the increase in potential max speed gradually declines starting at level 15 now.

Please note that the balls themselves have NO maximum speed and will continue to move faster for every level you advance.

The Electro-Blob should now not be able to touch you regardless of how big it is if you are in your safe zone.  Before this patch, sometimes the Electro-Blob could extend into your safe zone and electrocute you if it was very large.  This has been fixed now and should feel more "fair" if you are well inside your safe zone area.

Right now, you still also take a 30% point penalty for choosing to play without the Electro-Blob on all point scores except for accuracy shot bonuses given at the end of each level.

I hope you are enjoying my game, let me know in the forums or comments below!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.88 - Introducing the Deadly "Electro Blob" to Laser Ball! - Plus more!
notes.content:
Okay, the big news in this patch is that there is now a multi colored ball on every level.  When it comes up to shoot is all a matter of chance, but you'd hope it comes up later in the level than sooner!  Once you shoot the multi-colored ball to neutralize it, you'll unleash the deadly and dangerous new "Electro Blob"!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32345131/ecf4a4bbcdda2884ece38d66ce664e1f90a6944c.png[/img]

The Electro Blob doesn't actually hunt you down or chase you.  In fact it's just a big ball of pulsating billion volt electricity!  But because it packs so much power, it can be seen moving randomly all over the screen, sometimes doubling its size and other times compressing itself into a small ball of energy and darting all over the screen at crazy speeds!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32345131/06123ab5f6645aecf1011658a42a6dadfd402be6.png[/img]

If the Electro Blob touches you, you're as good as dead!  If it touches any ball you've made safe with the laser gun, then you'll hear a double deep drum sound alerting you of the danger!  DO NOT touch it as it will turn back to its original color and you'll need to get back to the control panel to try and neutralize it again!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32345131/c6e69634ef37771030ef25f18ab52bc7ddfb13a3.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32345131/6c9f784f4766ebf62718323d0bba21fb671c7d91.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32345131/b4b36ca3ac4c74563b17f2a18f5f0809f2ae6ec3.png[/img]

Other changes made in this update:

* The control panel is now solid and cannot be walked over.  The placement now prevents you from getting touched by acid if you are on the right side of it to access it.  In the safe zone, you'll be safe from the balls, but be right in the patch of acid once it starts filling up!  If you are on the right side of the panel to access it, you'll be safe from acid filling up, but be in harms way of the balls and/or the new Electro Blob!

* The acid is now half transparent and works much better than before.  Contacting it is pixel precise now, so no more getting an acid death from a few pixels away!  Yay!

* The countdown timer is now REAL time measure real seconds, not just a 1-100 timer as before this update.  This will allow much better and easier game balancing moving forward

* The Timer now starts at 1 min and 45 seconds at level 1 and goes down by two seconds for each level gained because of the faster moving balls giving you more freedom to move quicker through each level.  However, starting at level 15, 7 seconds will be added back to your timer for each level afterwards due to having to zig zag so much because of the fast moving balls.  The maximum time given on any level currently is 2 min, 59 seconds however.  These times may and will likely be changed to balance the game as needed moving forward.

* New sound effects added for the Electro Blob, including arcing electricity, a dramatic tune when he spawns each level and a heart beat that beats whenever he is on the screen.  You'll also hear a dramatic double tone sound when the Electro Blob contacts any safe ball you've shot with the laser, causing it to turn back to its original charged color.

* Several graphical tweaks were made to improve the overall look of the game as well.


Anyhow, I'm sure that this update might present a bug or two, but they will be quickly squashed once found!  Please help me squash any problems or bugs you experience by reporting them here or in the forums on the Bug Report sticky thread!

Also be sure you let me know how you like the new Electro Blob and all the recent changes, balances, and overall changes to the look and feel of Laser Ball in recent days!

Thanks for reading, enjoy the game, don't rage too hard at the new ball of lightning blob thingy, and have a great weekend!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.87 - "Hot Shot" Laser Accuracy Bonuses, "Quick Start" Allows You To Start At Level 5, Plus More!
notes.content:
With this update, I introduce a pretty substantial "Hot Shot" accuracy bonus to the game for precise shooting with your laser gun.  Also added to this game is a Quick Start feature to allow to skip the first five levels once you've progressed that far.. Lets' take what's new and explain each new item:


HOT SHOT ACCURACY BONUS:
-------------------------------------------------------
The reward is easy.. Simply 1,000 points multiplied by the level you achieve the shot accuracy on. (Level 5 would be 5,000 points, level 7 would be 7,000 points, etc)

To get this accuracy bonus, you'll need to be absolutely perfect with your laser fun shots. No missed shots. No hitting a ball that is already white. No hitting the wrong colored ball.

Now you'll have to balance the desire to get perfect shots with your timer counting down as well as the random light sparkles that might spawn every level. It's all up to you how you prioritize your tasks!

If you succeed at getting a "hot shot" bonus at the end of a level, you'll see a big display float up over the screen showing you how many bonus points you earned, and also hear a random chipmunk voice celebrating your successful shots. 


"QUICK START" FEATURE:
-------------------------------------------------------

With "Quick Start", you'll have the ability to start at level 5 with 25,000 points and 6 lives as if you made it to level 5, scored pretty well and added three more lives yourself!

This feature should help get experienced players back into the faster action immediately without needing to go through the first five slower levels time and time again!

To use "Quick Start", you'll need to first achieve scoring 25,000 points and having 6 lives on level 5 yourself first.  This will also give you a new Steam achievement as well.  Once you've gotten this new achievement, using "Quick Start" is as easy as checking the box on the main welcome screen.


OTHER ADDITIONS IN THIS PATCH:
-------------------------------------------------------

* Voice checkbox added to main welcome screen, allowing you to turn on or off all voices and the mans scream when he dies

* 6 New Steam achievements all the way up to level 50 and the new "Quick Start" achievement once you unlock that feature

* 8 Different chipmunk voices will scream or perhaps even sing and mock you for scoring perfect accuracy on a level.

* Mans scream added when he dies to running out of time, getting electrocuted, or when he suffers an acid death in the safe zone

* Borders now have dark grey behind all the text, making your score, your level, your lives remaining and every other indicator easier to read

* White neutralized ball design has been changed

* Algorithm added to ball mechanics to reduce the frequency of balls slowing down or getting stuck on the edges of the screen.  It's still not perfect yet but you should see this occurrence less often now.

* Average Ball Speed is now shown just below the level indicator



I hope you enjoy the new update! ..As always, let me know either in the forums or in a comment below! :-)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.86A - ALL USERS PLEASE READ, EXPLOIT/CHEAT DISCLOSURE EXPLAINED - Also Bug / Exploit within Game Code Has Been Fixed!
notes.content:
In my previous update, 0.84.. I had mentioned that I was aware of a rare situation that happened with me where sometimes I'd only deposit 8 balls before advancing to the next level.  

..This bug has been described to me and I'd like to thank Steam user Mellow_Online1 for bringing the bug to my attention.  Knowing "how" a bug happens is the biggest part of finding the fix and now that I know how the bug was happening, the fix was quick and easy to implement.  Thanks Mellow_Online!

The bug could have been used an an easy exploit to advance much quicker through the levels than intended as once learned, a user could advance a level having only deposited 4 or 5 balls, thus creating huge time bonuses and crazy high scores!  They would have made depositing those first 4 or 5 balls much harder twice as fast in abusing this bug as an exploit however.

This update, 0.86A fixes that bug and a follow up scoring patch will award players with a new way to score bonus points that should balance out any advantage a player who might have previously abused this bug as an exploit to score higher than otherwise would have been possible scores.

ALSO, I WANT TO POINT OUT THE FOLLOWING DISCLOSURE OF USING MY GAME ON STEAM IN THIS SAME ANNOUNCEMENT.  IT HAS NOT HAPPENED YET, AS NO SCORES LOOK TO HAVE BEEN MADE USING ALTERNATIVE METHODS OF CHEATING...

HOWEVER, IF ANY SCORE IS EVER POSTED THAT RAISES ANY SUSPICION ON MY PART AS THE DEVELOPER AS BEING A SCORE ONLY ACHIEVED BY USING A CHEATING OR HACKING METHOD, THAT SCORE WILL BE DELETED WITHOUT ANY QUESTIONS ASKED OF THE USER POSTING SUCH A SCORE.  MULTIPLE OCCURRENCES OF SUCH SUSPECT SCORES COULD RESULT IN A BAN FROM EVER BEING ABLE TO POST A HIGH SCORE IN LASER BALL.  SUCH DECISIONS ARE FINAL AND BASED ONLY ON MY GOOD JUDGEMENT AS THE DEVELOPER OF LASER BALL.  

Basically, don't "cheat" to try and post a high score, pretty simple.  As sales have seen an increase for Laser Ball lately, I want to make sure that I put this disclosure on record so it can be referred to later if there is a time I need to delete any suspect scores posted.

Thanks for playing (and reading) everyone!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.85 - MINOR VISUAL TWEAKS - Light Green Ball Is Now Brown To Avoid Confusion
notes.content:
Just like the title says, this is a very small patch, just changed the light green ball and matching border to a brown color to hopefully help any confusion in the chaos of the game between the two colors.

New dark texture background added to give the game something besides just a flat black background.

The color of the score indicators on ball deposits now match the color of the ball just deposited.

Also reduced the size of the deposit score indicator points slightly.

A cross or 'X" design has been drawn onto neutralized white balls now.


That's it!

Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.84 - SCORING CHANGES! - Plus NEW Score Indicators Show You Total Score Adds As You Get Them!
notes.content:
Update 0.84 adds in new scoring indicators that float above the action that generated them for a few seconds.  These indicators also show you negative scores that you might get for hitting the wrong colored ball with a laser beam.

In addition, this update adds floating reasons why you died above the location of your death, such as "Acid Death" if you touch the acid, "Electro-fried" if you touch a colored ball, or "Time Up!" if time runs out on you causing you to lose a life.

Scoring has been changed to better balance depositing balls in the deposit bin as I didn't realize how few points the game gave you for each deposit until I added the above mentioned scoring indicators.

Depositing a ball is now worth about 4x the value previously seen before this patch.  Each ball deposited is worth less points than the last ball because the level gets easier as you clear the balls out.  You'll now see the exact points scored for each ball you deposit with the score multiplier calculated for you.

Hitting the wrong colored ball with a laser beam is more costly than before.  The cost for each wrong ball hit with a laser has been increased from 15 points per level to 50 points per level.  For example, on level 3 now, if you neutralize the wrong colored ball with a laser, it will deduct 150 points from your total score.

Due to the increased speed of scoring, the first extra life is now 4,000 points (previously 1,000 points) and as before, the required points for each extra life doubles each time you earn an extra life.

The volume of the electricity from the balls was also reduced in this patch, as they seemed a little loud especially when 8 or 9 balls were on the screen.

-------------------

Known issue:

There is a known bug that sometimes happens where you'll advance a level when only 8 balls have been deposited.  Usually it works correctly, and usually all 9 balls need to be deposited before you'll advance a level.  

This isn't a game breaking issue, but I'm still trying to figure out exactly what causes this because it seems to happen only on a very rare occasion.  

There may be more issues or silly little bugs in the game due to all the recent changes I've made in the code with the recent changes made in update 0.83 and 0.84.  Please report them on the sticky thread for reporting bugs if you come across one and try to give as much detail as you can if you do report anything.

I hope you are enjoying all the recent changes I've made to Laser Ball to try and make it a more enjoyable gaming experience!

:-)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.83 - New Player and New Electricity Charged Ball Graphics! Lots More!
notes.content:
In this update, I changed the following:

- NEW PLAYER MODEL:  He looks better now, and is also shorter which helps maneuver him better and more safely in tough situations!

- NEW BALL TEXTURE:  All of the balls have been re-textured now to give them a better overall look.

- NEW ELECTRICITY SPARK EFFECTS ON ALL COLORED BALLS:  New charged effects appear around every colored ball, making it easier to see that these balls are dangerous to touch.

- NEW BORDER COLOR GRADIENTS:  New color gradients better reflect the ball that matches the ball colors that need to be shot with the laser gun to neutralize them as "safe to touch"

- NEW ELECTRICAL SOUND EFFECTS:  Every ball now sparks and puts of the sound of real electricity arcs.  The more colored balls that are dangerous to touch that are on the screen, the louder the sound effects of the electrical arcs and sparks will be!

SLIGHT INCREASE IN STARTING BALL SPEED:  The balls simply started too slow before, and this has been changed just a touch.  The starting speed of the ball movement now is just about the same speed as level 3 would have been before.  Yes, this makes the game a little more challenging starting out, but it also balances with the smaller player size and mobility in this patch as well.

LASER GUN STAYS IN LAST POSITION WITH EACH NEW LEVEL:  The laser gun used to be re-positioned at the top of the screen every time you advanced a level.  The gun now stays in its current position as you advance every level.  Only starting a new game will position the laser gun back at the top center of the screen.

MUSIC ADDED TO WELCOME SCREEN:  New Creative Commons music from Audionautix ("Whats It To Ya Punk") has been added to the welcome screen only.  The music not only helps set the mood of the game, but also gives you a reference of game volume when adjusting the game volume slider.

MOUSE CURSOR REMOVED DURING GAME:  While playing the game (not at the welcome screen), the mouse cursor is now hidden from view.  (If you have the windowed mode on, you can still see your mouse cursor if it's not positioned over the game window)

NEW ZAP SOUND ON CONTACT WITH CHARGED BALLS:  You'll now hear a loud electrical zap sound if your player gets electrocuted due to contacting a colored ball!

NEW PLAYER RE-SPAWN SOUND EFFECT:  When your player re-spawns, you'll now hear a new spawn effect.

PLAYER NO LONGER STOPS IN A RUNNING POSITION:  Player now stands normally when you aren't moving him.

---------------------------------------------

I think that's about it.  No scoring changes or anything drastic in that regard have been changed.  Your player still moves exactly the same speed as before, and the game still plays the same exact way.  This was mostly just an update to make the game look and sound better than before.  

I hope that you enjoy the changes!  Please let me know below!  

Also, if you have enjoyed Laser Ball.. Please consider letting me know with your opinions in a review here on Steam!  In fact, even if you hate Laser Ball, please feel free to leave a negative review, but if you do, please give specific reasons as to why you didn't enjoy it or why you didn't like my game.  My goal with every game I launch on Steam is to launch fun games to play that also offer a high replay value.  Reviews help me know how the public reception is for my games and as a new indie game developer, it is very valuable feedback that can help me grow and make my games better.  

- Thank you!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.82 - New In-Game Tutorial Teaches You "Hands On!" + Volume Slider + More!
notes.content:
In this update, I've removed the previous tutorial mode that was several screenshots of diagrams and text and replaced it with a more "hands-on-as-you-play" tutorial to walk players through the basics of the game objectives.  

Hopefully this new tutorial will help newcomers catch on to how the game is played without needing to read any instructions before jumping in and playing the game!

Other changes made in this update:

- Added a volume slider for the game on the welcome screen.

- Added a save feature to the game that saves your volume level and the last setting you had selected for the tutorial (checked or unchecked).  Whenever you launch Laser Ball now, your previously used settings on these two things will be loaded automatically.  (On same PC or other Windows device)

- Change in Scoring:  Scoring has been increased only in the situation that you drop all 9 balls into the Deposit Bin and have time remaining (not the red fast moving time).  If you succeed in delivering all the balls to the deposit bin before they turn white due to running out of time, you'll now get a much more substantial bonus.  The new bonus is 10 X the timer value, then take that number and multiply it by your current level.  For example, if you finish level 2 before the original timer runs out, and have 20 shown on that timer when you finish.. you'll get 10 x 20 = 200, then 200 x level 2 = 400 bonus points.  Previously the formula was the same except it was 3.5 X the timer then that multiplied by the current level.  So previously in the above example, the bonus would have been 3.5 X 20 = 70 X level 2 = 140 bonus points.  This new formula gives you almost TRIPLE the bonus points as before, so all the more reason to make every single second count! 

- The game now starts in full screen mode when launched.  (Alternating between full screen and windowed mode is still achieved by pressing the F key on your keyboard)

- In windowed mode, the game screen is now completely re-sizeable by just grabbing a corner of the window by holding your left mouse button and dragging to the desired size.

- From the Paused screen (accessed by hitting your ESC key on the keyboard or your START button on a controller).. you can now exit the game to the Welcome screen by hitting the Q key on your keyboard.  (The game gives you this information when the game is paused).  Exiting the game will cause you to lose your current game progress and score.

- The timer in game now shows a numerical value (counts down from 100 to 0)


...Hopefully these additions and changes make for a better game experience when you play Laser Ball now!  :-)

Have a great weekend all!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.81 - Controller Support Added + More Changes!
notes.content:
Controller support has been added to Laser Ball with this update and while the game itself doesn't display the new controls, they should be pretty simple to use.

CONTROLLER CONTROLS:

Left Stick = Move your player in any direction

To Rotate the Laser Gun:  You have the option of using either the left and right shoulder buttons or move the right stick left or right to rotate the fun clockwise and counter clockwise around the screen

A, B, or X buttons are used to Fire the laser gun and drop a ball in the deposit bin

The Start Button will pause and un-pause your game

The Select Button will swap between full screen and windowed mode

----------------------------------------------

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32345131/9a7d81ef33d4cb07e39357028464c4b0db3ddeaa.png[/img]

CHANGES MADE TO THE GAME:

- Added a new control panel access area to the right side of the control panel to show you where you can stand to access the control panel outside of the safe zone (handy to know and see if the safe zone is filling with acid)

- Added double point scoring if you collect a sparkle of light while carrying a ball over if you collect it while not carrying a ball.  This should make things more interesting during your games for those players trying to maximize their score!

- Changed the game to give you a chance to shoot the correct ball when you run out of time and all the remaining balls are white and you die trying to the collect the wrong white ball.  After dying, if all the balls are white because you had run out of time, you'll now have a short time period to shoot and collect the correct ball before the timer runs down again.

BUGS FIXED:

- Fixed an issue that prevented you from losing points sometimes if your laser hit multiple wrong colored balls in a single shot.  This has now been fixed and seems to be working as intended.

notes.title: New Tutorial Added As Launch Approaches Tomorrow!
notes.content:
In preparation for the launch on Steam tomorrow, I've patched the game adding in a new tutorial to help new players understand how the game works and how to play it.  It's a much more thorough step-by-step guide that explains the game with screenshots and diagrams to help new people understand the basic mechanics.

I've added arrow key support in this update for anyone who might prefer using the arrow keys to move their character instead of the WASD keys.  (you can use either the arrow keys or the WASD keys to move your character now)

Also changed in this update was a slight increase in the rate at which the timer counts down each level as you progress through the game.  Now, as you advance a level, every level, the timer will slowly move down faster than the previous level played.  This should help increase the challenge of the game in addition to the increase in speed of the bouncing balls for every level you advance.

I look forward to the response of players who buy and play my new retro action arcade game once it launches tomorrow!

Have a good weekend everyone!
